attachment.transientMeaning: Used only in this conversation: the file is read once, its bytes are discarded right after, and the extracted text stays with this conversation until you delete the conversation. It never becomes a source or a memory, and no other conversation can see it.
attachment.durableHint: This file will be added to your sources: read, its facts extracted and verified, kept with full provenance.
attachment.failed: This file could not be processed.
attachment.transientReady: Read for this conversation. Ask about it here; it was not remembered.
attachment.truncatedNote: The file was read in part; open the source for what was left out.
